sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up, dark-skinned male portrait, head and shoulders turned slightly toward screen-right, with a composed unsmiling mouth, short glossy black side-parted swept-back wavy hair, dark brows, a clearly visible narrow dark moustache and smooth chin. Large metal-framed aviator sunglasses have dark grey lenses and a double bridge; the covered eyes cannot be read through the lenses. He wears a warm brown suit jacket with broad notched lapels and a pale triangular pocket square at screen-left, over a light cream buttoned shirt with an open collar and no tie. Preserve the visible central shirt buttons, jacket opening and pocket square. Top/front-left highlights on hair and face contrast with deep shadows at the lower face and jacket. The shoulders and chest are cut by the bottom and side edges. The entire grey-brown painted vignette background is part of the original rectangular canvas; there is no photo-card frame, attached note or exterior cutout. Keep the whole rectangle and original dark background; do not cut the figure out. Exact 156x210 RGBA source alpha extrema243..255, visually complete backing. No medals or headwear are visible. Fine lens reflections are low-resolution painted detail, not extra eye accessories.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up dark-skinned male portrait, turned slightly toward screen-right with a calm serious expression and gently closed full lips, short glossy black side-parted combed-back hair, dark brows and a smooth chin. Gold-toned aviator sunglasses have large brown-tinted lenses, a narrow bridge and visible temples; exact eye detail behind the tint is not securely readable. There is no clearly delineated beard; the tiny upper-lip shading is not evidence for a distinct added moustache. He wears a reddish-brown suit jacket with notched lapels, a pale cream collared shirt and a straight dark olive-brown tie; retain the shirt collar and tie arrangement. The chest and shoulders run to the bottom and side crop. Soft highlights strike the upper face and hair, while the neck, collar and lower jacket stay dark. Preserve the complete grey-brown background with a darker upper vignette as an intact painted rectangle. No separate photograph frame, backing card, note, hat or visible medals. Do not add exterior transparency or remove the painted background. Exact 156x210 RGBA source alpha extrema254..255; visually solid painted canvas. The source itself limits tiny facial-hair and tinted-eye detail under visible-source-differences-v1; do not manufacture those details.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A chest-up dark-skinned male portrait in a slight screen-right three-quarter view, with short glossy black side-parted swept-back hair, dark brows, smooth chin and no distinctly delineated beard. Small upper-lip shadows are not securely separable as fine facial hair in this exact source. Round wire-framed spectacles have conspicuous pale lens reflections and gold-toned temples; keep the round glasses and their glare without inventing readable eye detail. A dark smoking pipe is held at the screen-right corner of the mouth: its narrow stem slopes down-right to a brown upturned bowl near the screen-right cheek/shoulder side. Preserve this pipe and the lips holding it. He wears a charcoal-grey sleeveless V-neck knitted vest with visible dark edge texture over a pale grey-white pointed-collar shirt and a dark red tie with a bright central highlight. Preserve the V-neck edge, exposed shirt collar, tie and the partially visible shirt sleeve at screen-left; this is not a suit-jacket outfit. Torso/shoulders are cropped by the lower and side edges; soft face and hair highlights contrast with dark neck and lower vest. The full grey-brown vignetted background fills the painted rectangle. No photo frame, note, separate card, hat or visible medals; preserve the entire canvas rather than making a transparent cutout. Exact 156x210 RGBA source alpha extrema254..255. Tiny upper-lip/eye details remain source evidence limits under visible-source-differences-v1.

Standalone full painted rectangle. A tightly cropped chest-up male portrait with a very large layered grey-taupe turban, thick grey brows, a stern furrowed expression and gaze slightly toward screen-left. The head is near frontal with a small screen-left turn. A thick grey moustache sweeps sideways over the mouth and joins a long full wavy grey beard; the small parted lip area is visible beneath the moustache. The turban has broad interleaved folds and rounded side bulges, nearly filling the upper width and touching/cropping at the top; preserve its shape, folds and placement. No eyewear is visible. Dark olive-grey military jacket with notched lapels, grey shirt and dark tie, gold piping around the shoulder straps, small round gold shoulder fittings and partially cropped gold lapel/chest emblems at the bottom. Preserve visible locations and broad emblem shapes without inventing tiny illegible insignia. The beard overlaps the central shirt/tie and lapel region; shoulders and lower chest are cut off by the rectangle. Upper-left face highlights and darker folds/beard shadows remain. Pale beige-grey mottled painted background fills the complete rectangle; there is no separate photo-card frame, note or cutout border. Keep the background and complete canvas. Exact 156x210 RGBA source alpha extrema249..255 with visually solid backing. Fine gold emblem symbols are below reliable source resolution; record that limit under visible-source-differences-v1 rather than guessing.
